prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit the supplied avatar. Make exactly TWO changes:
1. Cut the hair MUCH SHORTER into a close-cropped buzz cut: approximately 3–5 mm of hair on top, 1–2 mm on the sides, hugging the shape of the skull. Show fine short bristle texture and a neat natural hairline. Keep the dark hair and only a subtle small silver patch in the bristles at the front. Remove ALL longer strands, swept hair, fringe, spikes, tufts, quiff, and raised hair volume. This must look unmistakably like a BUZZ CUT.
2. REMOVE ALL digital/3D GLITCH effects. Completely eliminate floating cubes, detached fragments, rectangular shards, horizontal displaced slices, pixel artifacts, duplicated contours, cyan/magenta channel offsets and distorted hair or jacket edges. Reconstruct continuous clean natural outlines around the head, ears, collar and shoulders. The background must be uninterrupted magenta wherever there is no character. Keep the actual physical cybernetic eye, titanium facial plates, ear/neck hardware and their integrated cyan indicator lights; those are real parts of the character and must remain.

Preserve everything else: the SAME man's facial identity, age, olive skin, bone structure, short stubble beard, brown natural eye, cybernetic eye on the viewer's RIGHT, slight knowing expression, gaze directly at the camera, upright strictly frontal head and shoulders, dark high-collared technical jacket with ochre shoulder panel and off-white shirt, detailed stylized 3D rendering and materials. Keep the solid opaque vivid MAGENTA backdrop, target #D20A8C, across the entire square. Retain gentle physical rim lighting only, without colored channel doubling or visual distortion.

Same square head-and-shoulders crop and character scale, with clear space above the new much shorter hair. Clean finished avatar. No new elements, lettering, watermark, frame or props. Final result: FRONT-FACING, VERY SHORT BUZZ CUT, CLEAN RENDER WITH ZERO GLITCH EFFECTS.
